topPRs.title: ops: allow interop depsets across superchain dirs with a shared SuperchainConfig
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

`check_depsets` required every member of an interop dependency set to live in the same superchain dir. Node network names are `<chain name>-<superchain dir>` and are embedded in node binaries at build time. Adding chains from different dirs to one depset therefore forced a dir move, which renamed their networks and needed new node images (as with #1411 for sepolia-devnet-4/5).

This PR replaces the same-dir requirement with: every member's `superchain.toml` has the same `l1.chain_id` and the same non-zero `superchain_config_addr`. Members in the same dir pass trivially. The on-chain DisputeGameFactory/ETHLockbox equality check for activated chains is unchanged.

No chain configs, dirs, network names, `chainList.*`, `CHAINS.md` or genesis paths change. The existing `sepolia-devnet-4-5` dir stays as it is.

## Changes

- `ops/internal/manage/depsets.go`: `checkOffchain` compares the L1 and SuperchainConfig from the superchain definitions. Adds `LoadSuperchainDefinitions`. `NewDepsetChecker` takes the definitions map.
- `ops/cmd/check_depsets`: loads the definitions and passes them in.
- `depsets_test.go`: cross-dir cases (match, L1 mismatch, SuperchainConfig mismatch or missing, missing definition). The "actual depsets" test uses the real definitions.
- `superchain/configs/README.md`: documents the rule and the one-dir-per-devnet convention.

## Testing

- `go test ./internal/manage/`: pass
- `go run ./cmd/check_depsets` against the repo: pass (58 chains)
- `golangci-lint run` on the changed packages: clean

topPRs.title: sepolia-devnets: move OP Labs devnets 2-5 into one superchain dir
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Moves the OP Labs Sepolia devnets that share SuperchainConfig `0x289d2A1b1AE6E0470D8B72E53B6E3f485f251DBb` into one `sepolia-devnets` superchain dir:

| Chain | Chain ID | Old dir | New dir |
|---|---|---|---|
| sepolia-devnet-2 | 420130015 | `sepolia-devnet-2` | `sepolia-devnets` |
| sepolia-devnet-3 | 420130018 | `sepolia-devnet-3` | `sepolia-devnets` |
| sepolia-devnet-4 | 420130019 | `sepolia-devnet-4-5` | `sepolia-devnets` |
| sepolia-devnet-5 | 420130020 | `sepolia-devnet-4-5` | `sepolia-devnets` |

Devnets that join an interop dependency set in the future already share a dir, so `check_depsets` won't force another move or rename. `sepolia-devnet-6` stays in its own dir because it uses a different SuperchainConfig (`0xBbe1…Cc5A`).

Chain configs and genesis files are moved unchanged (pure renames). `addresses.json` is unchanged.

## ⚠️ Breaking for node operators

Node network names are `<chain name>-<superchain dir>` and are embedded in node images. They change as follows:

- `sepolia-devnet-2-sepolia-devnet-2` → `sepolia-devnet-2-sepolia-devnets`
- `sepolia-devnet-3-sepolia-devnet-3` → `sepolia-devnet-3-sepolia-devnets`
- `sepolia-devnet-4-sepolia-devnet-4-5` → `sepolia-devnet-4-sepolia-devnets`
- `sepolia-devnet-5-sepolia-devnet-4-5` → `sepolia-devnet-5-sepolia-devnets`

The chainList identifiers (`<dir>/<chain>`) change the same way. Merge this together with the matching devnets-private `superchain_registry.name` updates and new op-node / op-reth / kona-node / op-supernode / op-challenger / op-conductor images built against this registry commit, as was done for #1411.

## Changes

- `superchain/configs/sepolia-devnets/`: chain configs for devnet-2..5, plus `superchain.toml` (name `sepolia-devnets`, same SuperchainConfig, L1 and empty hardforks as the old dirs).
- `superchain/extra/genesis/sepolia-devnets/`: genesis files for devnet-2..5.
- `chainList.json`, `chainList.toml`, `CHAINS.md`: regenerated with `codegen --superchains sepolia-devnets`.
- `ops/internal/config`: `SepoliaDevnet2Superchain` → `SepoliaDevnetsSuperchain`, with its test references updated.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: example superchain name updated.

## Testing

- `check_depsets`, `check_genesis_integrity`, `check_chainlist`: pass
- `apply_hardforks`: no diff
- `go test ./internal/manage/ ./internal/config/`: pass

topPRs.title: Add lagoon (U22) activation timestamps for staging and FM customer chains
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Add the Lagoon (U22, Interop hard fork) activation timestamps for staging and the FM customer chains:

| Network | Date (UTC) | Unix timestamp |
|---|---|---|
| Staging (sepolia-devnet-4, -5) | Fri 13 Nov 2026 21:00:01 UTC (16:00:01 ET) | 1794603601 |
| Staging (sepolia-devnet-2, -3, -6) | Mon 30 Nov 2026 16:00:01 UTC | 1796054401 |
| Sepolia | Thu 10 Dec 2026 16:00:01 UTC | 1796918401 |
| Mainnet | Mon 11 Jan 2027 16:00:01 UTC | 1799683201 |

All follow the `16:00:01` convention used for Jovian and Karst.

## Files changed

- Mainnet: `op`, `soneium`, `ink`, `unichain`
- Sepolia: `op`, `soneium-minato`, `ink`, `unichain`
- Staging: `sepolia-devnet-{2..6}`

`lagoon_time` is set per chain only. It is deliberately **not** added to the Sepolia/Mainnet `superchain.toml` defaults, so `apply-hardforks` does not propagate it to other superchain-following chains for now.

## Context

Timestamps locked in ethereum-optimism/solutions#1676 (staging) and ethereum-optimism/solutions#1681 (Sepolia/Mainnet). `lagoon_time` is already supported by the `Hardforks` struct. Generated files are left to the daily automated codegen run.

topPRs.title: sepolia-devnet-4/5: one interop dependency set
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Makes sepolia-devnet-4 (420130019) and sepolia-devnet-5 (420130020) one interop dependency set, ahead of their `OPCM.migrate` (superchain-ops sep/125, ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1630).

Same layout as `rehearsal-0-bn` (#1070):
- Both chains move into one superchain dir, `superchain/configs/sepolia-devnet-4-5/`, because `check_depsets` requires every chain in a depset to share a superchain. `superchain.toml` is devnet-4's with `name = "sepolia-devnet-4-5"` (the old `sepolia-devnet-4` / `sepolia-devnet-5` files differed only by `name`).
- Genesis files move to `superchain/extra/genesis/sepolia-devnet-4-5/`.
- Each chain lists both `420130019` and `420130020` under `[interop.dependencies]`.
- `chainList.*` and `CHAINS.md` are regenerated with `just codegen <sepolia-rpc> sepolia-devnet-4-5`.

**Identifier / network-name change** (the only side effect):

| Chain | identifier | op-node / op-challenger network name (`<name>-<superchain>`) |
|---|---|---|
| sepolia-devnet-4 | `sepolia-devnet-4/sepolia-devnet-4` → `sepolia-devnet-4-5/sepolia-devnet-4` | `sepolia-devnet-4-sepolia-devnet-4` → `sepolia-devnet-4-sepolia-devnet-4-5` |
| sepolia-devnet-5 | `sepolia-devnet-5/sepolia-devnet-5` → `sepolia-devnet-4-5/sepolia-devnet-5` | `sepolia-devnet-5-sepolia-devnet-5` → `sepolia-devnet-5-sepolia-devnet-4-5` |

Nodes resolve these names from the registry embedded in their binary, so nothing changes for running nodes until a node build embeds this commit. When it does, devnets-private `stg/sepolia-devnet-5/manifest.yaml` `superchain_registry.name` must move to `sepolia-devnet-5-sepolia-devnet-4-5` in the same rollout. devnet-4 is not in registry mode.

**Timing:** both chains activate Lagoon at 1794603601 (Fri 13 Nov 21:00:01 UTC). After that, `check_depsets` also requires both chains' `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` / `EthLockboxProxy` to match, which only holds once sep/125 executes and `addresses.json` is updated. Merge before activation, or CI fails until then.

Locally: `check_depsets`, `check_chainlist` and `check_genesis_integrity` (both chains) pass; `apply-hardforks` produces no diff for these chains.

topPRs.title: sepolia-devnet-4/5: shared dispute contract addresses after OPCM.migrate
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Updates sepolia-devnet-4 (420130019) and sepolia-devnet-5 (420130020) addresses after their `OPCM.migrate` (superchain-ops sep/125). Execution tx: [0x0d52a31e…9c70](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x0d52a31e01af58767efb790efe6815f68b46ccb53008cd35c85df4e4d7729c70), block 12128478, 2026-11-13 20:56:12 UTC.

Generated with `just codegen <sepolia-rpc> sepolia-devnet-4-5`, which re-reads both chains' L1 contracts. `superchain/extra/addresses/addresses.json` changes:

| | sepolia-devnet-4 | sepolia-devnet-5 |
|---|---|---|
| DisputeGameFactoryProxy | `0x2D23…E1C4` → `0x38704731D7808b743b2A1b3d5656A460603C33A4` | `0x200F…56dB` → `0x38704731D7808b743b2A1b3d5656A460603C33A4` |
| AnchorStateRegistryProxy | `0x2C17…B089` → `0xC90Cf39f3D54aE699f908Bc5AECf0ed9c9429198` | `0x350E…5834` → `0xC90Cf39f3D54aE699f908Bc5AECf0ed9c9429198` |
| EthLockboxProxy | `0xB28b…3d6a` → `0x9B0B9F946e492327F58A5c1F39010A8B1e349429` | `0x4A36…7274` → `0x9B0B9F946e492327F58A5c1F39010A8B1e349429` |
| DelayedWETHProxy | unchanged (`0x1334…dfe6`, now the shared one) | `0x04F7…9269` → `0x13340f75B4F6F836028c930A3E6c44560c9bDfe6` |
| Proposer | unchanged | `0xefA9…10a4` → `0xB48Bc615DAf5E62ea4069adfaba17dc8c766F511` (the shared SUPER_PERMISSIONED game's proposer) |

Lagoon has activated, so `check_depsets` now runs its on-chain check: both chains in the `{420130019, 420130020}` depset (#1411) must report the same `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` / `EthLockboxProxy`. It passes locally with this change and fails on main without it.
